target: workflow.sh merge — a template region absent from the project is spliced in right after its after= anchor, not appended at file end
cmd: source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/workflow.sh"; source "$FIXTURES/workflow-fixture.sh"; wf_file project.js '// header comment' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=greet owner=plugin' 'console.log("hi");' '// @agentic-loop:end region=greet' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=notes owner=project' 'mine' '// @agentic-loop:end region=notes' '// footer comment'; wf_file template.js '// header comment' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=greet owner=plugin' 'console.log("hi");' '// @agentic-loop:end region=greet' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=footer owner=plugin after=greet' 'console.log("footer new");' '// @agentic-loop:end region=footer' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=notes owner=project' 'template notes ignored' '// @agentic-loop:end region=notes' '// footer comment'; wf_file expected.js '// header comment' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=greet owner=plugin' 'console.log("hi");' '// @agentic-loop:end region=greet' '' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=footer owner=plugin after=greet' 'console.log("footer new");' '// @agentic-loop:end region=footer' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=notes owner=project' 'mine' '// @agentic-loop:end region=notes' '// footer comment'; VERDICT=$(workflow_merge project.js template.js '//' '{}'); MATCH=$(cmp -s project.js expected.js && echo true || echo false); jq -n --argjson v "$VERDICT" --argjson m "$MATCH" '{verdict:$v, match:$m}'
_note: Regression guard for splice-at-anchor: a naive implementation could append new upstream regions at EOF instead of positioning them per after=, which would silently reorder generated files (e.g. a review-prompt region landing after an unrelated trailer instead of next to build-prompt). expected.js encodes the exact anchored position, including the blank line the splice logic inserts before the new block, and confirms the pre-existing project-owned region is undisturbed by the insertion.
